correctness.rationale: The exact global nonlinear coefficient equals the maximum local averaging-block derivative norms because polyhedral projection is continuous piecewise-affine and every block partition has a strictly complementary witness. The first-difference transfer matrix has nonnegative rows, maximum column sum 1, and interblock row sums half adjacent block lengths. For at least three blocks its squared spectral norm is at most (n-1)/2; two-block squared norms are exactly n/3+(1/a+1/b)/6. The exceptional n=2,3,4 comparisons are explicit. Strict-complementarity plus explicit gradient directions realize each quotient for every cap vector. Exact rational checks cover 1013 partitions, 400 small KKT projections, 200 nonlinear pairs, and 33 strictly complementary sharp witnesses. Computer checks corroborate, not substitute for, the unrestricted proof.

value.rationale: The result gives a sharp all-dimensional and all-cap stability law for the classical LPAV/isotonic quadratic projection under a natural gradient-energy geometry. It shows exact sqrt(n/2) amplification despite data-fit Euclidean nonexpansivity and path total-variation contraction. The two finite exceptions, five-site central-block transition and independence from heterogeneous positive slope caps give substantive quantitative structural information for discretized smoothness and denoising; not a parameter substitution, table recomputation or merely an exhaustive small case.
